user.title: Sign in to Dreamehome
user.description:
Use the email and password of your Dreamehome account. The integration works through Dreame's cloud, so it needs internet access.

**Sign in to Dreamehome with Google or Apple?** Those can't be used here. Add a password to your account first: in the Dreamehome app, open **Profile → Settings → Account and Security** and set a password.

data_description.region: The region your Dreamehome account was created in.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Dreame rejected the saved password for {username}. Enter the current one.

error.invalid_auth: Dreame rejected the email or password. Check the region too. After several failed attempts Dreame may block sign-in for about an hour.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Dreame's cloud. Try again in a moment.

abort.already_configured: This dehumidifier is already set up.
abort.no_devices: No dehumidifiers that aren't already set up were found on this account.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the dehumidifier. Shorter intervals mean more requests to Dreame's cloud.

unsupported_model.title: {name} isn't supported yet
unsupported_model.description:
Dreame Dehumidifier doesn't have a profile for the model {model} yet, so it hasn't created any entities. Sending commands meant for other models can upset some devices, so it won't guess.

To help add support, map the model with tools/probe.py and open an issue on GitHub with the reports.
